name: Quick Hourglass
notes: A floor item (an hourglass with cream caps and yellow sand running down). Only the player can pick it up: walking into it plays the item chime, floats '-5% RECHARGE' over the player and keeps the boost until the run ends. All 3 of the player's moves take 5% less time to recharge for the rest of the run (move_buttons charge_var): move 1 in 2.85 s instead of 3 s, move 2 in 9.5 s instead of 10 s. It lies at a random one of 9 spots each run (one per screen of the map, all reachable and out from under the tree tops, away from the start, the monsters' homes and the sleeping Alpha); the scene places it at the first.
